notes: Common confidence P/R/F1 use a 0.001 floor and IoU 0.50 one-to-one matching; AP uses IoU 0.50 through 0.95.
DMS operating metrics apply Phone/Cup/Bottle thresholds 0.20/0.35/0.40 and the existing 0.85 maximum box-area filter; only Cigarette threshold varies.
The dataset test split shares source-video prefixes with train/validation and is not an independent scene-level test.
